name: Mistral AI
instructions: Create an API key at https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys then set it in the preferences below.

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.description: Ask Mistral AI a question ("model" to pick the model, "reset" to clear the history, "last" to show the last answer)

language.name: Interface language
language.description: Language of the items shown by the extension (the manifest itself cannot be translated)

default_model.name: Default model
default_model.description: Overridden by the choice made via the "model" subcommand

system_prompt.name: System prompt
system_prompt.description: Instructions given to Mistral for every conversation

history_size.name: History size
history_size.description: Number of exchanges kept as context (0 = disabled)
